events.title: Salmon Glacier Viewpoint, Stewart, BC
events.thought: End of day forty-three. The glacier looms above.

events.title: Jigsaw Lake, BC
events.thought: Jigsaw Lake — the kind of spot that makes you recalibrate what 'beautiful' means.
events.photoCaption: Waldo lakeside at Jigsaw Lake Recreation Site, BC, as a photographer scans the water.

events.title: Salmon Glacier Summit View
events.thought: The Salmon Glacier doesn't prepare you — nothing does. It just sits there, massive and ancient.
events.photoCaption: The Salmon Glacier pours through its BC valley from the summit viewpoint near Stewart, an enormous river of ancient ice.

events.title: Waldo at Salmon Glacier Viewpoint
events.thought: Waldo at the Salmon Glacier viewpoint — the scale of it doesn't register until you're standing there.
events.photoCaption: Waldo parked at the Salmon Glacier summit viewpoint, the massive blue-white glacier filling the valley below.
